advices.diagnosis: The class has a very high number of methods (NOM=26) and a high cumulative cyclomatic complexity (WMC=56), indicating a single class is doing too much. The LCOM4 value of 5 shows the method‑attribute graph has many disconnected components, meaning the class is not cohesive. All attributes are private (DAM=1.0), but the class still couples to four distinct responsibilities (order lifecycle, pricing, audit, notification) and references four other project classes (DCC=4). This violates the Single Responsibility Principle and makes the class hard to maintain and test.

suggestions.title: Split OrderService into dedicated component services

advices.risk_notes: The refactor will increase the number of classes and may raise the DCC metric. It also introduces more moving parts, which could complicate testing and deployment if not managed carefully.
